main_text.head: PSALMVS CXLV. Constat 21. verf. Heb. totidem Latinis.
main_text.p:
1. Enarrabo Dei laudes, & Regis honores
Perpetuo recinam.

2. Altisoni Domini laudabo nomen in horas,
Nomen vbique feram.

3. Quanta eius virt[?]s & inscrutabile Numen,
Quam sapienter agat.

4. Stirps omnis stirpi referet miracula rerum,
Strenua facta Dei.

5. Splendorisque fui maiestatisque decora
Cantor & author ero.

6. Me praecone tuo & scriba cantabitur vsque
Qua tua sit pietas.

7. O quam perfacilis pacatu, tardus ad iram,
Prodigus est venia!

8. Lenis vbique Deus, mira dulcedine cunctos
Nos amat ex animo.

9. Sera eadem soboles, Domini cantabit amorem
Iustitiamque canet.

10. Ex opere ipse suo celeber laudabitur author,
Quem pia turba colet.

11. Quoquo te vertas Domini laus vna micabit
Imperiumque potens.

12. Gloria per totum Domini vulgabitur orbem,
Cognita erit populis

page.notes: Verse numbers 1–13 are printed in the left margin beside the lines. The page is set in roman type with italic verse lines. The heading "Psalmus CXLV" is printed in spaced capitals. The running head is set in small capitals. Doubtful letters: "virt[?]s" (the word is partly obscured by the printed "u" in "virtus"); "praecone" has an uncertain final letter, since the 'e' is slightly smudged. Verse 13 is cut off at the line end, as printed. Reading order was taken as printed. Some words in the lines may appear slightly differently from the scan due to ink quality.
